issue.title: Successor Offers — pick which unblocked tasks to pull in after a close
issue.description: Closing a task that unblocks other tasks (in Obsidian, bob capture, or Bob Mac Capture) still recovers everything immediately, but no successor Task Link is created automatically. Instead one grouped picker per gesture offers the direct dependents, every available task of a project whose ^prj the close unblocked (the sase.md ^bar → sase_foo.md case), and the emptied-project / parent-project ^prj pull-ins, with no 5-successor limit. Only the picked tasks are linked, raised to Next, and stamped fresh.
